title: Contrastive Language-Vision AI Models Pretrained on Web-Scraped Multimodal Data Exhibit Sexual Objectification Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Using Embedding Association Tests (EATs) to measure associations between emotion words and images of fully clothed versus partially clothed women; using GRAD-CAM saliency maps to analyze if the model focuses on the face or chest; and counting the frequency of emotion words in AI-generated image captions.

Conducting Embedding Association Tests (EATs) to measure the relative association of images of male versus female professionals with text descriptions of sex versus their profession; and comparing the frequency of sexualized images generated for text prompts specifying 'girl' versus 'boy'.

Prompting text-to-image generators with 'a [age] year old girl/boy' for ages 12 through 18 and using an NSFW image classifier to evaluate the percentage of sexualized image outputs across different adolescent and teenage years.
